existingSurfaceEvidence.fact: Existing canonical member route requires a session and active membership, derives tenantId, preserves new-claim-page-ready, and currently renders ClaimWizard.
Current wizard is a 250-line legacy file, persists only to localStorage key claim-wizard-draft, and calls the real submitClaim action; it cannot be the dormant implementation shell.
Existing schema stores the six supported fact groups with access-tenant and owner-user RLS predicates and enforces tenantId equals accessTenantId.
Existing create path is owner-scoped, request-id idempotent, capped at 200 drafts, and emits only content-free free_start_draft.created audit metadata.
Existing list/resume path is owner-scoped, paginated, and emits only free_start_draft.resumed audit metadata.
Existing update/delete path is owner-scoped and version-checked, with content-free update/delete audit metadata.
Existing action context fails closed outside an accepted neutral host or when default public tenant and session access tenant differ.
Existing 147-line hook already supplies explicit save, resume, update with conflict handling, delete, pagination, and start-another behavior.
Existing save copy already states no claim, case, payment, membership, or coverage decision is created and that supported draft facts remain until permanent deletion.
Rejected claims-row path generates a claim number, records case.created, and writes claim.created audit even at draft lifecycle state.
Agent queue filtering requires an assigned agent but does not independently exclude draft lifecycle, so a claims-row draft is not a safely isolated preparation store.

productContract.heading: Prepare your claim draft
productContract.supportingCopy: Save the facts you have now and return later.
productContract.truthPanel: Draft only — this does not create or submit a claim, assign a case, notify a team, or start review.
productContract.disabledActionExplanation: Submission will be enabled only after the claim safety checks are ready.
productContract.accessibility: Disabled submission remains perceivable with adjacent explanation; save/manage controls remain keyboard reachable; async status uses existing live-region behavior; focus moves to validation or resumed content; no color-only state; 200% zoom and mobile reflow preserve action order.

acceptanceCriteria: P00 proves the existing free-start action boundary works unchanged for the exact canonical neutral-IDA pilot host and default-public-tenant active member; otherwise stop.
The canonical route, session redirect, active-membership gate, diaspora query parsing, and new-claim-page-ready marker remain intact.
The active-member route body no longer renders or imports ClaimWizard for this slice.
Only vehicle and property may be saved; injury/health is visibly unsupported and never persisted.
An explicit save stores only the six existing free_start_drafts fact groups; nothing saves automatically.

The same verified member can close the browser context, return to /member/claims/new in a fresh context on the accepted host, list the draft, resume every stored fact, update with CAS conflict safety, and delete permanently.
Submit remains disabled and inert in every state and locale; no submit handler, keyboard activation, form fallback, URL transition, or server action exists.
No claims row, claim number, claim counter, claim lifecycle/event, document, upload, AI run, notification, provider call, billing action, callback, or deployment behavior occurs.
No draft is visible in member claims tracking, agent/staff/admin queues, or claim detail because no claim entity exists.
Unsupported host/account context fails honestly with the existing accountContext copy and performs no write.
EN, SQ, SR, and MK expose equivalent draft-versus-submit truth; German remains outside pilot scope.
Every new code file remains below 150 lines, and the 250-line legacy ClaimWizard is not modified or enlarged.
The measurable cross-session-resume target reaches at least 90 percent in the defined 10-session protocol while zero claim-side effects are proven.
hardStopConditions: P00 needs any edit to apps/web/src/proxy.ts, neutral-otp-boundary, session resolution, shared-auth, tenant concepts, canonical routes, or host policy.
Any required fact cannot round-trip through the existing free_start_drafts contract.
Cross-session resume requires localStorage, a new table/column/index, a migration, an RLS policy, a broad grant, or a claim row.
The UI cannot make submission inert without importing or wiring submitClaim, createClaim, updateDraftClaim, submitFreeStartIntake, or an equivalent writer.
Any supported-host failure is hidden, mislabeled as saved, or silently falls back to device-local persistence.
The accepted 8 production/config and 4 test/spec file ceilings would be exceeded; return to design gate rather than expand.

operators.name: Progressive
operators.observations: Users review details before submitting; confirmation, claim number, representative activity, and tracking begin only once the claim is filed. New-report and existing-claim actions remain distinct.

operators.name: GEICO
operators.observations: The public flow asks for a small core fact set, treats additional facts as helpful rather than universally blocking, separates report from track, and starts confirmation/management only after completion of the report.

operators.name: State Farm
operators.observations: File a claim and Track a claim are separate primary actions; review, estimates, payment, and claim-team behavior are described as downstream of filing.

operators.name: Sun Life eClaims
operators.observations: The flow supports save-for-later and dashboard resume for in-progress work, preserves a summary/review step, and distinguishes saved work from the final Submit Form action and confirmation.

comparisonCriteria: Truth boundary between preparation draft, filed/submitted claim, and tracked claim
Cross-session resume discoverability and recovery without duplicate entry
Progressive disclosure of a minimum useful fact set before submission
Separation and accessibility of save/manage actions from the irreversible submit action

betterThanBaseline.metric: Successful fresh-browser-context resume of a supported saved draft without creating or submitting a claim
betterThanBaseline.method: Run 10 bounded same-member sessions on the accepted neutral IDA host. Save in one browser context, clear device-local state by opening a fresh context, return to /member/claims/new, and score success only when every persisted fact resumes and claim/event/counter side-effect snapshots remain unchanged. The current localStorage-only ClaimWizard baseline is 0 percent in a fresh context by construction.

benchmark.antiCopyTradeDressBoundary: Adopt only abstract interaction principles: explicit draft truth, separate reversible save/resume from irreversible submission, progressive disclosure, and a visible review boundary. Do not copy operator wording, screen order, component geometry, colors, icons, imagery, branding, illustrations, motion, typography, or trade dress.
